# Eylace

> Eylace is a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace in Bangladesh offering electronics, fashion, home and lifestyle products with nationwide delivery and local payment methods (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, COD).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, deals and category browse.
- [Categories](/categories): Full product category directory.
- [Deals](/deals): Current discounts and offers.
- [Flash Sale](/flash-sale): Time-limited promotional sales.
- [Best Sellers](/best-sellers): Top-selling products.
- [New Arrivals](/new-arrivals): Recently launched products.
- [Trending](/trending): Popular products right now.
- [Blog](/blog): Shopping tips, tech and fashion editorial.
- [About](/about): Company mission, vision and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Support email, phone and office address.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions on orders, payment, shipping, returns and accounts.
- [Help Center](/help): Self-service help articles.
- [Shipping Info](/shipping): Delivery times, costs and coverage.
- [Returns & Refunds](/returns): Return policy and process.
- [Track Order](/track-order): Look up an order by number.
- [Seller Center](/seller-center): Information for prospective sellers.
- [Affiliate Program](/affiliate-program): Earn commission referring sales.
